spells.name: Booming Blade
spells.components: Somatic, Material (a melee weapon worth at least 1 SP)
mechanics_first: **Melee Weapon Attack:** you must make a melee attack with a weapon.
**Sheathing Sound:** on a hit, the target becomes sheathed in booming energy.
spells.lore_and_flavor: A favorite cantrip of arcane tricksters.

spells.name: Fixture Mind Whip
mechanics_first: **Save & Damage:** the target must make an Intelligence saving throw.
**At Higher Levels:** you can target one additional creature for each slot level above 2nd.
**Aftermath:** the target is stunned until the end of its next turn.
spells.lore_and_flavor: Tasha designed this spell to scramble her enemies' focus.

spells.name: Fixture Ritual Spell
mechanics_first: **Detection:** you sense the presence of something.
